title: Semantic role taxonomy
description: The design system vocabulary. A role has four parts: tokens (base declarations), states (selector suffix -> declarations), when (axis value -> declarations), behavior (lint-only flags the emitter never reads). Every value is a token name from the active adapter or a literal from vocabulary.json keywords; an array is a space-joined multi-value declaration.

states.description: Key is a selector suffix from vocabulary.json stateSelectors, e.g. ":hover" or "[data-state=\"open\"]". Explicit selectors replace CORE-IDEA.md's `"bg:hover"` magic-key convention, which made the compiler guess at pseudo-state expansion.

when.description: Key is "<axis>=<value>", e.g. "size=sm". Both halves are validated against axes.json.

interactive.description: Lint-only: interactive roles must declare a ":focus-visible" state. The emitter does not read this.

propertyNames.description: Must be one of vocabulary.json properties.

anyOf.description: A token name or a keyword.
Space-joined multi-value declaration, e.g. ["space-xs","space-s"] -> `padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-s)`.

additionalProperties.description: `transition` is special: exactly [css-property, duration-token, easing-token]. That shape is enforced by the resolver, not by JSON Schema.
